occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection. The last available inspection was dated 10/2024
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: The fire alarm system sounded multiple times on and off during the inspection. There a notice on the alarm box that stated " trouble smoke". Last doucmented inspection from the alarm company was dated 11/15/2024.    NOTE: According to director the alarm will sound when it is windy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The food served was not reflective of the posted menu. The menu stated, breaded chicked, ground beef, apples      According to staff, children were served chicken sandwiches, corn, and fruit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - height=depth: A slide was observed on the playground with no loose-fill or unitary surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - height=depth (26 TAC §746.4901(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The playground was not observed to be maintained. Pieces of plastic, styrofoam cups, paper, torn rugs and fabric was on the playgroud. There was an unknow wire on the groud, leading away from the playground. A slide was observed to be cracked, Two basketball goals were lying on the groud, surrounded by trash. Several children were observed to be lying on torn/broken nap cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): Of the 6 staff records reviewed, 5 staff including the director did not have the preemployment affidavit completed and on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the infant and toddler rooms, caregivers personal bags, were observed to be within reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information sent to licensing via text from reporter incident report was not shared with parent of their child who had a cut on the lips and a bump on the back of his head.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a hole on the wall in the indoor play area. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Date of admission was missing on file for one file checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Emergency Medical Authorization was missing on one file checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Doctors information was missing on fiile for one file checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: There was no List of children just brought into the Center by the caregiver who brought them from Elementary school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: It is observed that the operation has not back background check fees of $4.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: There was no first aid kit in the vehicle used to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: There was no acknowledgement that one staff received any orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies: One staff file did not have any acknowledgment that she received any Policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(7)(A))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Fire extinguisher in the van used for transportation was not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One out of four children file did not have Emergency Medical Authorization information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infant feeding sheets were not updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: A copy of drivers's license was missing on one out of four files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Annual training hours was missing for one staff who is currently out of the country.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: Date of employment was missing on file for one out of four files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Special needs information was missing on file for five out of eight files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Immunization record was missing on file for one out of eight files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: One out of eight children records checked did not have doctor's information, Emergency medical authorization, two records did not have special needs information, one record did not have school age information and one record did not have health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: A two dollars background check fees has not been paid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two out of four staff files checked did not have current first aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23,2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
